details.title: Melodic minor scales
details.lead: Melodic minor as jazz players use it, the same up and down: natural minor with the 6th and 7th raised. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
